title: Evaluation bound |T(ω)| ≤ ∫ |ω| dμ_T for an integer multiplicity current (parent step 9(d))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n). Then ofReal|T(ω)| ≤ ∫⁻ ofReal(|ω(x)|) dμ_R(x), where μ_R := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) and |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), R.Represents T → ENNReal.ofReal |T ω| ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) ∂R.measure
